kurinye_oladi_ovoschnaya_fantaziya.title: Chicken & Veggie Fritters with Mushrooms
kurinye_oladi_ovoschnaya_fantaziya.description: Crispy golden fritters made with ground chicken, zucchini, bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms.
steps: Finely dice the onion and bell pepper, chop the mushrooms into small cubes, and grate the zucchini, then squeeze out the excess liquid.
Mix the vegetables and mushrooms with the ground chicken, then stir in an egg, flour, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Heat a skillet with oil over medium heat.
Spoon the mixture into the skillet, shaping small fritters about 1.5 cm thick.
Cook covered on low heat for 5–6 minutes per side until golden brown and the meat is no longer pink inside.
Transfer the fritters to paper towels and serve hot.

en.why: Sauté chicken at high heat first to render fat and lock in juices; low heat makes it rubbery. Stir constantly to avoid sticking and burning.
en.swaps: Replace honey with 5g maple syrup for a less sweet taste. Use 10g frozen peas instead of cucumber for convenience.
en.mistakes: Overcooking rice turns it mushy. Check texture after 10 minutes of simmering; it should be firm but tender.
en.keep: Eat fresh or store for 2 days in the fridge; reheat chicken and veggies in a dry pan for 3 minutes. Freeze without egg.
en.serve: Pair with a cold glass of green tea or miso soup to balance the meal’s richness and heat.

chicken_bowl_rice.title: Chicken Bowl with Rice and Vegetables
chicken_bowl_rice.description: Balanced lunch: rice, chicken in teriyaki-light sauce, crunchy vegetables and egg, sprinkled with sesame.
steps: Rinse the rice in cold water, cut the carrot into 0.5 cm julienne, cut the cucumber into 1 cm long slices, boil the egg hard for 7 minutes, dice the chicken into 2 cm pieces, prepare a 24 cm skillet, and heat it over medium heat.
On a preheated 24 cm skillet over high heat, sauté the chicken for 6 minutes until golden at the edges, stirring.
Add minced garlic to the chicken, pour in the soy sauce and honey, mix and warm for 1 minute so the chicken soaks up the sauce.
Add carrot and cucumber to the chicken, cook over medium heat for 4 minutes until tender, stirring frequently.
Assemble the dish: spread the rice on the bottom of the plate, top with the chicken and vegetables and the egg halves, sprinkle with sesame.
Serve hot, garnish with extra sesame if desired, and enjoy immediately.

rulet_iz_kurinogo_okoroka_i_omleta.title: Chicken Breast Roll with Omelet
rulet_iz_kurinogo_okoroka_i_omleta.description: A rolled chicken breast stuffed with a creamy omelet and leek, baked in foil. Serve in warm or chilled slices.
steps: Whisk eggs with mayonnaise and a pinch of salt, let rest for 5–10 minutes.
Pour the mixture onto a greased skillet, cover, and cook on low heat for 4–5 minutes without flipping until the omelet sets. Cool.
Separate the chicken breast from the bone, keeping the skin intact, and flatten into a thin layer.
Tenderize the meat with a mallet, season with salt and pepper.
Slice the leek into thin rings and sprinkle over the meat.
Cover the meat with the omelet, roll tightly into a log, secure with kitchen twine, and wrap in foil.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40–45 minutes until the juices run clear and the internal temperature reaches 185°F (85°C).
Let the roll rest for 10 minutes, remove the twine and foil, and slice into pieces.

kurinye_grudki_v_gorchichnom_souse_s_ris.title: Chicken Breast in Mustard Cream Sauce with Rice
kurinye_grudki_v_gorchichnom_souse_s_ris.description: Sliced chicken breast in a tangy cream-mustard sauce with caramelized onions, served over steamed rice.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook in salted water for 15–18 minutes until tender, then drain.
Slice the onion into half-rings and sauté in oil for 3–4 minutes until just translucent.
Cut the chicken breast into strips, season with salt, and cook with the onions for 6–8 minutes until golden-brown.
Stir in the mustard and sour cream, mixing well.
Simmer the sauce on low heat for 3 minutes until it just begins to bubble; the chicken is done when no pink remains inside.
Serve over the rice.
